ledger: olives in first jar | green | mixed green and black | color changes from green to black mid-air while pouring
olives in second jar | green | mixed green and black | color changes from green to black while pouring

findings.description: The small jar initially contains only green olives, but as they are poured into the large jar, several black/dark purple olives fall out, changing color mid-air.
The second small jar also appears to contain only green olives before being poured, but black olives fall from it into the large jar.
